notes.text:
This update for gvfs fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-28295: information disclosure when processing untrusted PASV responses from FTP servers (bsc#1258953).
- CVE-2026-28296: arbitrary FTP command injection due to unsanitized CRLF sequences in user supplied file paths
  (bsc#1258954).

A remote attacker could exploit this input validation vulnerability by supplying specially crafted file paths containing carriage return and line feed (CRLF) sequences.
